posts.cooked:
I have to admit I've thought about it. After all, I did design a MLP crochet pattern last year.

The difficult bit would be deciding on the colours, and getting the cutie marks to look perfect.

Legacy - I guess white, blue mane/tail.

Tachyon - white, red mane/tail, those red rings on her legs.

Bunker - I'd add layers of plating to bulk him up, not sure how the mane/tail would work.

AZ - similar, what to do about the mane/tail?

Wraith - got to have some purple, don't know what other colours. Tricky.

I'd have AZ with a black body with blue highlights and an electric blue mohawk mane and tail.

Wraith, not sure about the body, but her hoofs would be purple and she'd have white wraps going up her legs and a cape going over her mane (black).

Bunker is hard, but could you do occasional lines of 'bumps' (not sure how to describe it) to represent bolts? That way you could enschew a mane/tail altogether.

 

Also a quick suggestion about pony types. Legacy should be a pegasus. Tachyon and AZ should be unicorns. And Bunker and Wraith should be earth ponies.
